time.description: When the asset was captured, RFC 3339. `null` when the original did not record it.
time.title: Time

Acquisition.title: Acquisition
Acquisition.description: When an asset was captured, and on what equipment.

AnatomicalConvention.description: Axis convention of a frame. Handedness fixes chirality, not orientation.
AnatomicalConvention.title: AnatomicalConvention

Asset.description: One file or directory the container carries or references.

id.description: Stable identifier of the asset within this container, unique across `assets[]`.
id.title: Id

kind.description: What the asset is, which fixes how a reader should treat it.

visit.description: Id of the visit this asset belongs to.
visit.title: Visit

uri.description: Path inside the ZIP for a carried asset, or `sha256:<hex>` for a referenced one. A referenced original occupies no path at all.
uri.title: Uri

media_type.description: IANA media type of the payload.
media_type.title: Media Type

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the payload, lowercase hex. For a directory asset it is the digest over `parts[]`, not over concatenated bytes.
sha256.title: Sha256

bytes.description: Size of the payload in bytes; the sum over `parts[]` for a directory asset.
bytes.title: Bytes

frame.description: Id of the coordinate frame this asset's coordinates are expressed in. It MUST be reachable from the canonical frame.
frame.title: Frame

acquisition.description: When and on what equipment it was captured.

load_priority.description: Hint for a reader fetching by HTTP range: lower loads first. A hint, never a requirement.
load_priority.title: Load Priority

regulatory.description: Regulatory layer and clearances of this asset's content.

projection.description: Projection geometry, for 2D radiographs only. `null` for everything else.

parts.description: One entry per file when the asset is a directory, such as a DICOM series. This is what lets a validator say which slice is wrong instead of 'the series does not match'.
parts.title: Parts

sidecar_uri.description: Path to a JSON sidecar describing the payload, so a reader can inspect it without a parser for its format.
sidecar_uri.title: Sidecar Uri

derived_from.description: Ids of the assets this one was derived from. Required for anything under `derived/`: an inference with no stated input cannot be audited.
derived_from.title: Derived From

series_instance_uid.description: DICOM Series Instance UID `(0020,000E)`, so a recipient holding the series by another channel can tell it is this one.
series_instance_uid.title: Series Instance Uid

external.description: True when the asset is referenced and not carried. Acquired originals MUST be external; their `uri` is then a content address and never a path.
external.title: External

locators.description: Where to find this asset when it is referenced and not carried. Hints, never a contract: a reader verifies by hash and MUST open the container without resolving any of them. An empty list is NOT DECLARED.
locators.title: Locators

Asset.title: Asset

AssetKind.description: What kind of thing an asset is.
AssetKind.title: AssetKind

Clearance.description: What one jurisdiction says about this asset.

jurisdiction.description: Regulator the statement is made before, e.g. `EU` or `US`. A status without a jurisdiction means nothing.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

regime.description: Regulatory framework under that jurisdiction, e.g. `MDR` or `FDA-510k`.
regime.title: Regime

status.description: What this jurisdiction says about the asset under that regime.

reference.description: Dossier or clearance number when one exists. `null` is 'not recorded here', never 'there is none'.
reference.title: Reference

Clearance.title: Clearance

ClearanceStatus.description: Closed vocabulary for a clearance status.
ClearanceStatus.title: ClearanceStatus

Consent.description: What the patient consented to, which bounds purpose of use.

fhir_consent.description: Reference to the FHIR `Consent` resource that records it. The container carries the pointer, never the document.
fhir_consent.title: Fhir Consent

scope.description: Purposes the subject consented to. An empty list is 'not declared'.
scope.title: Scope

Consent.title: Consent

Deidentification.description: What was done to de-identify, in the vocabulary of DICOM PS3.15 Annex E.

profile.description: DICOM PS3.15 Annex E confidentiality profile applied, by its standard name.
profile.title: Profile

options.description: Named options applied on top of the profile, e.g. `CleanRecognizableVisualFeatures` for defacing. This is where a reader learns whether the face was removed.
options.title: Options

applied_to.description: Asset ids the de-identification was applied to. Assets not listed were not processed.
applied_to.title: Applied To

tool.description: Software that performed it, so a recipient can tell a documented pipeline from a manual pass.

date_shift_days.description: Constant offset applied to every date, in days. Needed to compare two visits after shifting; `null` means dates were not shifted.
date_shift_days.title: Date Shift Days

note.description: Free text for anything the fields above cannot express. Not machine-readable by design.
note.title: Note

Deidentification.title: Deidentification

Device.description: The equipment, with fixed keys and no serial number.

manufacturer.description: Equipment manufacturer. Fixed key rather than free text so two containers can be compared.
manufacturer.title: Manufacturer

software_version.description: Version of the software running on the equipment. No serial number is carried: it identifies a machine, and through it a site.
software_version.title: Software Version

Device.title: Device

Extension.description: A format extension the container declares and may require.

name.description: Prefixed extension name. This specification reserves `histora_` and defines no other.
name.title: Name

version.description: Version of the extension, independent of the format version.
version.title: Version

uri.description: Path to the extension's payload inside the container, declared as an asset like any other.
uri.title: Uri

schema_id.description: Identifier of the schema its payload validates against.
schema_id.title: Schema Id

description.description: One line on what the extension adds, so a reader that skips it can say what it skipped.
description.title: Description

Extension.title: Extension

FHIRResource.description: Which FHIR R4 resource an asset corresponds to.

resource_type.description: FHIR resource type this asset maps to, e.g. `Observation` or `ImagingSelection`.
resource_type.title: Resource Type

resource.description: Reference to the resource instance, when one exists outside the container.
resource.title: Resource

note.description: Why this mapping was chosen. Free text, for the reader who disagrees with it.
note.title: Note

FHIRResource.title: FHIRResource

Frame.description: A coordinate system in which asset positions are expressed.

id.description: Stable identifier of the frame within this container.
id.title: Id

description.description: Human-readable name of the frame. Free text, and never load-bearing.
description.title: Description

units.description: Length unit of coordinates in this frame. Millimetres everywhere in this version.
units.title: Units

handedness.description: Handedness of the axes, `right` or `left`. A reader that ignores it renders a mirrored case that looks correct.
handedness.title: Handedness

anatomical.description: Anatomical axis convention, such as `LPS` or `RAS`. `null` is NOT DECLARED, and is not the same as a device convention.

dicom_frame_of_reference_uid.description: DICOM Frame of Reference UID `(0020,0052)`. Read from the series, never invented: it is the only frame identifier that means the same thing outside this container.
dicom_frame_of_reference_uid.title: Dicom Frame Of Reference Uid

Frame.title: Frame

Locator.description: Where to find a referenced original. A hint, never a contract: identity is decided by the hash and not by the route.

value.description: The locator itself: a QIDO-RS query, an AE title, a URL, or an institution-local reference.
value.title: Value

identifying.description: Whether the locator itself carries identifying information, such as a patient directory in a URL or an AE title that names the clinic. It has no default on purpose: silence here would be indistinguishable from having checked.
identifying.title: Identifying

note.description: Anything a recipient needs in order to use it, such as which network it is reachable from.
note.title: Note

Locator.title: Locator

LocatorKind.description: How a locator expresses a location: DICOMweb, an AE title, a URL, or an institution-local reference.
LocatorKind.title: LocatorKind

OcclusionRecord.description: How the mandible-to-maxilla relation was recorded.
OcclusionRecord.title: OcclusionRecord

PHIState.description: Explicit PHI state. No value of it makes a container non-personal data.
PHIState.title: PHIState

Part.description: One file inside an asset that is a directory, such as a DICOM slice.

name.description: Path of this file inside the directory asset. Names are ordering data for a DICOM series, so they are carried even though identity does not depend on them.
name.title: Name

sha256.description: SHA-256 over the whole file, lowercase hex. Proves these exact bytes.
sha256.title: Sha256

bytes.description: Size of the file in bytes.
bytes.title: Bytes

sop_instance_uid.description: DICOM SOP Instance UID `(0008,0018)`. The identity DICOM itself defines, and what survives de-identification when UIDs are retained.
sop_instance_uid.title: Sop Instance Uid

pixel_data_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the value of the PixelData element `(7FE0,0010)` alone, without the header. De-identification does not touch it, so it separates 'a different slice' from 'the same slice, cleaned'.
pixel_data_sha256.title: Pixel Data Sha256

Part.title: Part

Projection.description: What kind of 2D image an asset is, and which teeth it targets.

type.description: Projection geometry of a 2D image, e.g. `panoramic` or `bitewing`.
type.title: Type

fdi_targets.description: Teeth the projection is aimed at, in FDI/ISO-3950. An empty list is 'not declared', never 'no teeth'.
fdi_targets.title: Fdi Targets

Projection.title: Projection

Provenance.description: The append-only hash chain linking versions of this case.

prev_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the previous version's manifest. This is what makes the history a chain rather than a claim.
prev_manifest_sha256.title: Prev Manifest Sha256

chain.description: Path to the append-only chain file. Present without `prev_manifest_sha256` means a history exists that this manifest does not point into.
chain.title: Chain

Provenance.title: Provenance

PurposeOfUse.description: Closed vocabulary for what a container was issued for.
PurposeOfUse.title: PurposeOfUse

Registration.description: A rigid transform taking points from one frame to another.

id.description: Stable identifier of this registration edge.
id.title: Id

source_frame.description: Id of the frame points are taken from.
source_frame.title: Source Frame

target_frame.description: Id of the frame points are taken to.
target_frame.title: Target Frame

transform_4x4_row_major.description: The rigid transform as sixteen numbers, row-major, millimetres. glTF expects column-major, so a reader targeting glTF MUST transpose.
transform_4x4_row_major.title: Transform 4X4 Row Major

method.description: How the transform was obtained, e.g. `icp_surface` or `manual`.
method.title: Method

rms_error_mm.description: Root-mean-square residual of the fit, in millimetres. It is measured on the points that were fitted, so it is systematically optimistic.
rms_error_mm.title: Rms Error Mm

max_error_mm.description: Largest residual over the fitted points, in millimetres. An RMS hides a local failure that this exposes.
max_error_mm.title: Max Error Mm

target_registration_error_mm.description: Registration error measured at points that did NOT take part in the fit, in millimetres. This is the error a clinical measurement across the seam actually inherits.
target_registration_error_mm.title: Target Registration Error Mm

tre_region.description: Where the target registration error was measured. A TRE without its region is not comparable with another.
tre_region.title: Tre Region

fit_for.description: What this registration is accurate enough for, declared rather than inferred from the residual. An empty list is 'not assessed'.
fit_for.title: Fit For

computed.description: When the transform was computed, RFC 3339.
computed.title: Computed

operator.description: Who or what produced the estimate. A machine here with an empty `verified_by` means provisional.
operator.title: Operator

verified_by.description: Who checked it. `null` means nobody did, and a viewer MUST present the edge as provisional.
verified_by.title: Verified By

regulatory.description: Regulatory layer of the transform itself, when it was produced by a model rather than fitted.

Registration.title: Registration

RegistrationFitness.description: What clinical use a registration was measured fit for.
RegistrationFitness.title: RegistrationFitness

Regulatory.description: The regulatory layer of an asset and its clearances.

layer.description: Regulatory layer of the content: 1 acquired or transcribed, 2 computed deterministically from layer 1 with no trained model, 3 model output. Layer 3 MUST live under `derived/`.
layer.title: Layer

clearances.description: What each regulator says about this asset. An empty list is 'nothing declared', not 'cleared everywhere'.
clearances.title: Clearances

Regulatory.title: Regulatory

pseudonym.description: The subject's pseudonym. Always a pseudonym: a direct identifier MUST NOT appear here.
pseudonym.title: Pseudonym

fhir_patient.description: Reference to a FHIR `Patient` resource held elsewhere. A pointer, never the record.
fhir_patient.title: Fhir Patient

consent.description: What the subject consented to, and for which purposes.

Tool.description: The program that applied the de-identification.

name.description: Name of the software that performed the operation.
name.title: Name

version.description: Its version string, as the tool reports it.
version.title: Version

sha256.description: Digest of the tool binary or image, when the writer can compute it.
sha256.title: Sha256

Tool.title: Tool

id.description: Stable identifier of the visit within this container.
id.title: Id

date.description: Date of the encounter. Shifted when `deidentification.date_shift_days` is set.
date.title: Date

label.description: Human-readable name for the encounter. Free text.
label.title: Label

Visit.title: Visit
Visit.description: One clinical encounter the assets belong to.

description: The manifest of a Unified Oral Scene container. Derived from the reference implementation's contract rather than written by hand: a schema copied by hand diverges from the code at the first field somebody adds.

uos_version.description: Format version this container declares. A reader MUST check it before anything else.
uos_version.title: Uos Version

case_id.description: Stable case identifier, conventionally `urn:uuid:<v5>`. It MUST NOT encode patient identity.
case_id.title: Case Id

created.description: When this manifest was written, RFC 3339 in UTC.
created.title: Created

generator.description: Who wrote this container: name and version of the writer.
generator.title: Generator

phi_state.description: What identifiable content the container carries. It is a statement about the whole container, and a reader decides what it may do with it from here.

deidentification.description: What de-identification was applied, to which assets, and with what tool. `null` means none was declared, which is not the same as none being needed.

purpose_of_use.description: What this container was assembled for. It bounds what a recipient may do with it, and is checked against the subject's consent.

canonical_frame.description: The frame every other frame must be reachable from. It is the geometric hub of the case.

frames.description: Every coordinate frame named in the case, besides the canonical one.
frames.title: Frames

visits.description: The temporal axis: one entry per clinical encounter.
visits.title: Visits

assets.description: The data plane: every file the container carries or references. The manifest is exhaustive, so a reader never walks the ZIP to discover content.
assets.title: Assets

registrations.description: The relations: the transforms that place each frame with respect to another, each with its residual.
registrations.title: Registrations

occlusion.description: How the two arches relate, for a case that has both. Silence is never 'there is none': a two-arch case MUST declare a registration or say why it cannot.

fhir_map.description: Which FHIR resource each asset maps to, so a clinical system can ingest the case without knowing this format.
fhir_map.title: Fhir Map

extensions.description: Extensions this container declares, by name.
extensions.title: Extensions

extensions_used.description: Names of extensions present. A reader that does not implement one still opens the case and can say what it left unread.
extensions_used.title: Extensions Used

extensions_required.description: Names of extensions a reader MUST implement to open the case correctly. Listing one here refuses readers, so it is for cases that would be misread otherwise.
extensions_required.title: Extensions Required

provenance.description: The link to the previous version of this case, and to the chain that records every version.

title: UOS manifest v0.2
